metadata.dcterms:title: THE PTOLEMY FIELD OF 3-MANIFOLD-REPRESENTATIONS
metadata.dcterms:creator: STAVROS GAROUFALIDIS, MATTHIAS GOERNER
ZICKERT, CHRISTIAN K.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The Ptolemy coordinates for boundary-unipotent SL(n, C)-representations of a 3-manifold group were introduced in [7] inspired by the A-coordinates on higher Teichm¨uller space due to Fock and Goncharov. In this paper, we deﬁne the Ptolemy ﬁeld of a (generic) PSL(2, C)-representation and prove that it coincides with the trace ﬁeld of the represen- tation. This gives an eﬃcient algorithm to compute the trace ﬁeld of a cusped hyperbolic manifold.
